metadata.description: Claude Code skills for day-to-day dev workflow: PR summaries, ticket journals and branch-scoped test coverage.

plugins.name: pr-summary
plugins.description: Consistent English PR descriptions (Summary + Test plan) built from the branch's real diff.

plugins.name: ticket-plan
plugins.description: Cross-repo work journal: one plan.md per ticket, kept up to date through its lifecycle.

plugins.name: branch-test-coverage
plugins.description: Unit tests for the lines changed on your branch, following the repo's test patterns. Test files only.
